info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Portfolio Management API
info.description: The Customer Portfolio Management API facilitates the creation and management of customer portfolios within a banking environment. This endpoint allows businesses to effectively analyze and organize client investments, ensuring optimal asset distribution and performance tracking. Financial institutions and investment managers can use this API to improve client engagement and tailor offerings based on portfolio insights. By leveraging this API, developers can streamline portfolio management processes and enhance decision-making capabilities.

post.description: This operation allows users to create a new customer portfolio, enabling effective management of customer accounts and insights into customer data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a customer portfolio for analysis. It should contain all relevant data required for processing the customer's portfolio, including their business metrics, financial information, and any other necessary details that will aid in the analysis.
